Release 1.4.2+26

Improvements:
* Refactored note detail page into modular section components for better maintainability
* Added shared helpers for commands, dialogs and text watchers used across pages

Fixes:
* Fixed auto-generated ids not assigned to inserted note items
* Fixed note attachments not cloned correctly when copying note state
* Fixed medicine reminder days not copied when cloning a reminder
* Fixed note item logger initialization
* Fixed note date formatting to use correct locale
